titles.english: Crayon Shin-chan: Pursuit of the Balls of Darkness
titles.native: 映画 クレヨンしんちゃん　暗黒タマタマ大追跡

description: Shinnosuke found a black marble near a sleeping travestite and Himawari swallows it. That marble is necessary for summoning an evil demon, so the Noharas are chased by some ninja clans.
